summary.description: 3-6 plain sentences: how this stretch was spent, in the order it happened.

timeline.description: Consecutive, non-overlapping stretches covering the whole window from its start to its end. Every second belongs to exactly one stretch.

present.description: Was the person at the Mac?

present_why.description: The evidence for present, in a few words.

doing.description: What the person was doing, in plain words, specific: the thing, not the app.

task.description: A short label for the task this stretch belongs to. Reuse the exact same label for stretches of the same task, so switches can be counted.

where.description: App, and site or document when known.

actions.description: Things the person did (sent, typed, searched, clicked to decide, created, joined, shared). Not things that merely appeared on screen.

people.description: People the person dealt with (talked to, messaged, worked with, discussed).

projects.description: Projects or pieces of work advanced.

other.description: Other things going on: shows watched, purchases, errands, news followed.
